messages:
Tom S.: Flagging urgent onboarding failure for Beaconly — provisioning API returns 403 on embed key mint. Customer is mid-trial, seats blocked, CSM flagged as renewal risk. Logs below.

Aisha K.: :eyes: can you paste the error payload and which deploy touched the tenant? Who's oncall?

Tom S.: Paste: ```POST /v1/tenants/beaconly-42/keys
403 {
  \"error\": \"forbidden\",
  \"reason\": \"tenant-key-mismatch\"
}```
We saw this right after the key-rotation job ran at 09:54.

Tom S.: Short-term: reissue key for tenant fixes flow. Long-term: need mapping check in rotation job.

Ravi P.: I'll own the reissue/workaround and a safety revert. ETA ~20m. Creating a small script to rebind tenant -> key. @Lina M. can CS do an expectation-setting note to the customer?

Lina M.: Yes — I'll send a quick honest note. Proposed external message: ```Hi Sam — we noticed a provisioning hiccup that affected your trial embeds. We're reissuing a connection key now and can run a 15-minute enablement call to validate everything. ETA 30 minutes. Apologies for the disruption — Lina, CSM.```

Aisha K.: Comms/triage play (quick):
1) Send short external note (Lina)
2) Run workaround & confirm (Ravi)
3) Offer 15-min guided enablement and record session notes (Aisha)
4) Update Zendesk ticket + flag renewal-risk -> follow-up cadence (Tom)

Tom S.: Zendesk ticket created #48512, priority=P1, internal incident link: https://redwood.internal/incident/48512 (internal).

Ravi P.: Workaround steps I ran: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/beaconly-42/keys/reissue -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS'``` — reissued key, validated embed handshake, now returning 200 and tokens accepted. Confirmed test render on staging and prod proxy.

Lina M.: I just sent the external note and scheduled a 10:30 PT call with Sam. Invite sent. :calendar:

Aisha K.: After the call we'll capture detailed feedback in the onboarding survey and update the renewal-risk tag. If call goes well, mark as "at-risk -> monitored".

Tom S.: I'll add postmortem notes to the ticket once Ravi drops the rotation patch. Thanks all — good quick cross-team work. :thumbsup:
